cases.oracle: Independent finite Kitty direct RGB/RGBA and POSIX shared-memory consumer follows the official graphics protocol; query success/rejection, m continuation, q quiet replies, complete-image placement, C cursor policy and typed geometry are decoded from actual PTY bytes. Frame1 a=f replacement and a=c/N=2 composition are explicitly a Kilix profile, not general Kitty conformance. Native guarded Python PTY query/reply and owned shm read/unlink, literal positive/negative consumer controls, independently decoded PNG/PPM assets, Python Unicode and separate canvas math validate expectations in setup. No GNU GPU API, GLES, shader, DMABUF or physical rendering equivalence is claimed. Causal phase controls use independently behaving good, deliberately wrong and timeout native poll clients; wrong-ID and malformed matching-ID replies are observed separately before any matching reply.

Full untouched PTY wire, per-packet payloads and intermediate composition pixels, actual helper replies/suppression, owned shm inode/data/unlink observations, geometry, syscall readiness, modes before/during/after input, elapsed intervals and original shell output stay in diagnostics. No sent key or FAIL implies an unexecuted later phase. The peer records exact wrong/malformed/matching bytes, remembered-PID owned-tty poll, zero queued input, raw termios, time, no terminal modes and no command acknowledgement before releasing the matching reply.
